short_description: A supine butterfly stretch that gently opens the hips and inner thighs while you relax on the floor.
how_to: Lie on your back and bring the soles of your feet together.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Place your hands on your belly or rest them by your sides.
Relax and hold the position, breathing slowly.
correct: Relax your hips toward the floor.
mistakes: Don't lift your head off the floor.

short_description: A wide-stance squat that targets the inner thighs, glutes and quads.
how_to: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width and toes turned out.
Place your hands in front of you or on your hips.
Lower your hips until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Repeat for the full set.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't lift your heels off the floor.

short_description: A calf raise with toes turned inward that shifts emphasis to the inner calf muscles.
how_to: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and toes turned slightly inward.
Hold a support if needed for balance.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Repeat for the full set.
correct: Rise to your full height on each rep.
mistakes: Don't let your ankles roll outward.

short_description: A squat hold with small pulses that increases time under tension in the quads and glutes.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Hold that position and pulse up and down a few centimetres.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
Complete all pulses before standing.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep the pulses small and controlled.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast into the start position.
Don't rise up fully between pulses.

exercise_name: Wall Resisting Single Leg Calf Raise
short_description: A single-leg calf raise pressing into a wall that builds unilateral calf strength and balance.
how_to: Stand facing a wall and place both hands on it at chest height.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor and balance on the other.
Press your hands into the wall as you rise onto the ball of your standing foot.
Lower your heel slowly back down.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
correct: Rise to your full height on each rep.
mistakes: Don't let your standing ankle roll.
Don't lean your whole body weight into the wall.

short_description: A squat combined with an overhead reach that works the legs, glutes and shoulders together.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Lower into a squat with your arms down in front of you.
As you stand, raise both arms overhead.
Lower your arms as you descend into the next squat.
Repeat in a smooth, flowing rhythm.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your chest upright at the bottom.
Move your arms with control, not momentum.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't shrug your shoulders at the top.

short_description: A standing side lunge stretch that lengthens the inner thigh adductor muscles.
how_to: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with its foot flat on the floor.
Hold where you feel a stretch in your inner thigh.
Switch sides and repeat.
correct: Keep your bent knee over your toes.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
mistakes: Don't let your knee cave inward.

short_description: A rotational crunch that targets the obliques by bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
how_to: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and rotate one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and alternate sides.
Repeat for the full set.
correct: Keep your elbows wide, not squeezed forward.
Rotate from your torso, not just your elbow.

short_description: A ballet-inspired wide squat that targets the inner thighs, glutes and quads.
how_to: Stand with your feet wider than hip-width and toes turned well out.
Place your hands on your hips or in front of you.
Lower your hips straight down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to return to standing.
Repeat for the full set.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't lean forward from your hips.
Don't let your heels lift off the floor.

short_description: A side-lying lower leg lift that isolates the inner thigh of the bottom leg.
how_to: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line.
Bend your top leg and place that foot flat on the floor in front of you.
Keep your bottom leg straight.
Lift your bottom leg a few centimetres off the floor.
Lower it with control and repeat, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your bottom leg straight throughout.
Keep the movement slow and deliberate.
mistakes: Don't swing your leg for momentum.
Don't let your hips roll backward.
